rationale.f1: Identifies the base monolingual model (the Bayesian model of garg2012unsupervised), which is the direct answer to 'what does an individual model consist of'.
rationale.f2: Describes that roles are predicate-specific, a structural property of the individual model that meaningfully rounds out what the model 'consists of' beyond just naming its base.
rationale.f3: Describes the Primary/Secondary role division mechanism used to model ordering and repetition preferences, another structural component of the individual model that a full answer to 'what does it consist of' should include.
